chapter: Lil, Oliver and the Hot Five
title: Buddy Bolden's fate and Armstrong's fame in Alcorn's youth
summary: Alcorn recalls Bolden losing his mind and being forgotten, while everybody in his time talked about Louis Armstrong.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
